name: Home Run Simulator
desc:
Increase your Strength, Accuracy, and Focus to become the best baseball player ever!

Unlock new bats and balls, win striking contests, unlock new arenas, get home runs, and more!

Participate in sports challenges and tournaments to prove your skills and climb the leaderboard!

🌟Represent your team in on Strike a Baseball!

Formerly known as: House of Highlights Home Run Simulator
